_u.a_interview_e: Interview team members to get feedback on your leadership style and interact with them.
_u.a_interview_title: To better understand the status of employees, which of the following actions do you plan to take during the interview...
_u.a_interview1_e: You listen to their thoughts or concerns about work, provide detailed guidance to address concerns, and tell them what to do and how to do it.
_u.a_interview2_e: You listen to their thoughts or confusions about work, emphasize how to do the job well, and answer their questions.
_u.a_interview3_e: You listen to their thoughts or doubts about work, discuss the issues in their doubts together, give them confidence, and clarify the next steps.
_u.a_interview4_e: You listen to their thoughts or suggestions about work, encourage them to try, and then set a time to discuss progress.
_u.a_meet_e: Team meetings give you the opportunity to communicate with the team and plan your goals for the coming weeks. You can also use this opportunity to get feedback from team members.
_u.a_meet_title: To hold an efficient meeting, pay attention to each team member's work status and your leadership style. Which of the following actions do you plan to take...
_u.a_meet1_e: Before the meeting, circulate the relevant information within the team and ask each team member to think in advance. During the meeting, list the points you think should be included in the work tasks, require team members to execute your work plan, and follow up on their execution.
_u.a_meet2_e: Before the meeting, circulate the relevant information within the team and ask each team member to think in advance. During the meeting, share the work plan you have prepared with the team members, allow them to voice their confusions and concerns, explain the prominent difficulties, but you make the final decision on the content of the work plan.
_u.a_meet3_e: Before the meeting, circulate the relevant information within the team and ask each team member to think in advance. During the meeting, share your goals with the team members. Ask them about their concerns, assist them in exploring options to achieve the goals, and encourage each member to actively participate, reaching a consensus on the implementation of the work plan.
_u.a_meet4_e: Before the meeting, circulate the relevant information within the team and ask each team member to think in advance. During the meeting, based on their ideas for goal implementation, add your suggestions as appropriate, and emphasize that they must complete the tasks within the deadline.
_u.a_meet1-ve_e: Excessive meetings with the team. Hinders work progress and the meetings lack new ideas. Work progress lags, and team morale is low.
_u.a_meet2-ve_e: Excessive meetings with the team. Hinders work progress and the meetings lack new ideas. Work progress lags, and team morale is low.
_u.a_meet3-ve_e: Excessive meetings with the team. Hinders work progress and the meetings lack new ideas. Work progress lags, and team morale is low.
_u.a_meet4-ve_e: Excessive meetings with the team. Hinders work progress and the meetings lack new ideas. Work progress lags, and team morale is low.
_u.a_reward_e: Reward employees with outstanding performance, recognizing their special contributions to the company.
_u.a_reward_title: If you plan to reward him/her, which of the following actions will you take...
_u.a_reward1_e: Consider their situation during the recent salary adjustment or performance bonus distribution.
_u.a_reward2_e: Give them the best performance rating in the recent performance evaluation.
_u.a_reward3_e: In the recent work arrangement, based on their ability and willingness, let them take on a leadership role, give them authority, and affirm their performance.
_u.a_reward1-ve_e: Rewarding employees when team morale is not ideal
_u.a_reward2-ve_e: Rewarding employees when team morale is not ideal
_u.a_reward3-ve_e: Rewarding employees when team morale is not ideal
_u.a_email-crit_e: Send critical messages. Criticize the recipient's poor performance, ask the recipient to reflect seriously and correct mistakes.
_u.a_email-prai_e: Send praise messages. Acknowledge the recipient's excellent performance and encourage them to continue working hard for better performance.
_u.a_email-prai-ve_e: Sending praise messages when team morale is low
_u.a_goal_e: Setting goals allows you to interact with team members and send them tasks and important events for the next week.
_u.a_goal_title: To set effective goals for him/her, which of the following actions do you plan to take...
_u.a_goal1_e: You provide some methods on how to set goals and regularly check, track, and review them.
_u.a_goal2_e: You provide specific suggestions on how to set goals, listen to their response, and make corresponding explanations. Follow up on the goal setting and promptly affirm what is done well.
_u.a_goal3_e: You listen to their concerns about setting goals, discuss possible actions together, but do not make decisions directly.
_u.a_goal4_e: You express confidence in their ability to set goals themselves and will regularly check on progress.
_u.a_swap-ve_e: Excessive execution of position swaps among team members causes chaos.
_u.a_team-lunch_e: All team members have lunch together to soften the atmosphere and optimize team morale.
_u.a_team-build_e: Participate in team-building activities to establish team culture.
_u.a_team-lunch-ve_e: Over-focusing on team-building activities, the activities did not achieve the expected results.
_u.a_team-build-ve_e: Over-focusing on team-building activities, the activities did not achieve the expected results.
_u.a_trg_e: Skill training to improve employees' professionalism in business.
_u.a_trg-3_e: Send them to a three-day training to let team members understand the basic information of the product.
_u.a_trg-5_e: Send them to a five-day training to let team members deeply understand the product knowledge.
_u.a_communicate_e: Report to senior leadership, discuss team status, and strive for necessary resources.
_u.a_communicate-ve_e: Excessive reporting to senior leadership, resulting in counterproductive effects.
_u.a_criticise_title: If you plan to criticize him/her, which of the following actions will you take...
_u.a_criticise1_e: Point out the recent problems in their work, ask about the process, confirm the reasons for the performance decline, and discuss solutions with them.
_u.a_criticise2_e: Point out their careless personality, which has led to the recent performance decline; establish a follow-up action plan to improve their personality flaws.
_u.a_criticise3_e: Point out their careless personality, which has led to the recent performance decline; establish a follow-up action plan to improve their personality flaws.
_u.a_criticise4_e: Ask for their views on the recent performance decline, express your concerns and admit your responsibility for improper management, understand the ins and outs of the matter, and discuss measures and improvement plans with them based on specific reasons.
_u.a_praise_title: If you plan to praise him/her, which of the following actions will you take...
_u.a_praise1_e: Use the recent opportunity to specifically praise their behavior.
_u.a_praise2_e: Try to assign important work to them so that others can understand their new role.
_u.a_praise3_e: Encourage them to work harder and indicate that you will publicly praise them when there are specific results as motivation.
_u.a_praise4_e: Encourage them to work harder and indicate that you will publicly praise them when there are specific results as motivation.
_u.a_praise5_e: Ask them what kind of motivation they expect? You will try to satisfy them.
_u.a_assign_title: To delegate tasks to him/her, which of the following actions do you plan to take...
_u.a_assign1_e: When assigning work tasks, clearly explain the deadlines, priorities, and tasks that must be completed. Arrange a tracking schedule to monitor progress.
_u.a_assign2_e: When assigning work tasks, provide a plan on how to carry out these tasks, including deadlines and priorities. Listen to their confusions and encourage them to follow your suggestions, monitoring progress.
_u.a_assign3_e: When assigning work tasks, understand their concerns about the tasks, discuss task implementation plans with them, and encourage and support their ideas. Follow up with regular meetings to understand project progress.
_u.a_assign4_e: When assigning work tasks, emphasize the importance of the task to the company's future, ask them to contact you when encountering problems, and provide assistance as much as possible.
_u.a_challenge_title: Since you took office, Mingfan's attitude towards you has always been indifferent, but there has been no quarrel. You have heard that before you took over as the head of this department, Mingfan had high hopes and thought he was the ideal candidate. You understand that Mingfan is adopting a passive and uncooperative attitude. You want to have an interview with him to improve your relationship with Mingfan. How should you start the interview with him?
_u.a_challenge1_e: First tell him about your plan to promote him in the future.
_u.a_challenge2_e: First ask him about the reasons for his indifferent and cold attitude towards you.
_u.a_challenge3_e: First tell him that you affirm his loyalty and contribution to the company.
_u.a_challenge4_e: First ask him for his views and suggestions on improving department performance.
_u.a_challenge5_e: First tell him that you will rely on his expertise to help you complete some important work, and ask for his thoughts.
_u.s_instruct_e: The leader sets specific goals for subordinates, makes plans, sets priorities, instructs details, teaches step by step, and checks and provides feedback in a timely manner.
_u.s_coach_e: The leader explains the ins and outs of the task and gives specific requirements. When subordinates do well, affirm them in a timely manner. Continuously guide subordinates to set work standards and encourage and praise them more.
_u.s_partner_e: The leader makes decisions together with subordinates. The leader is more about guiding, listening, encouraging, and supporting. Listen more to subordinates' opinions and suggestions. Encourage subordinates to try to solve problems themselves.
_u.s_deligate_e: The leader delegates tasks to subordinates to complete independently. Give more trust, affirmation, and recognition. Give subordinates more challenges. The leader reduces involvement in planning and control of details. The leader delegates daily tasks to subordinates but provides support and help at any time.
_u.t_scout_e: The development department searches for market demand for the product and submits a demand outline to the evaluation department for verification before proposing.
_u.t_evaluate_e: Evaluate the cost, risk, and return of the demand based on the collected information. Submit a proposal if it meets the company's internal standards.
_u.t_propose_e: Prepare and submit a proposal based on the collected information.
_u.t_negotiate_e: Discuss the submitted proposal with the client, explore the feasibility of the proposed project, and reach a consensus on the project.
_u.t_close_e: Discuss contract details with the client, confirm terms, and sign the contract.
_u.e_loweff_e: Work performance has suddenly declined. You find that personal reasons have led to poor performance and may hinder the work of others.
_u.e_360fb_e: In your 360-degree feedback, team members mentioned that they are exhausted and in urgent need of rest.
_u.e_badprod_e: Product review websites have criticized the functionality of our product. The website stated that competitors' products have already adopted these features and that our product lacks innovation.
_u.e_dropeff_e: Work performance has suddenly declined. You find that personal reasons have led to poor performance and may hinder the work of others.
_u.e_fin_crisis_e: The impact of the economic recession, to reduce costs, the entire company has to lay off employees and reduce salaries. You are asked to reduce the salaries of team members.
_u.e_drop_morale_e: Work morale has suddenly dropped due to lack of recognition/rewards. You find that they feel neglected because they did not receive your congratulations.
_u.e_new_crm_e: Your company has adopted a new customer relationship management system, and employees have to enter information electronically. Some people are not technically skilled, and they do not like this change.
_u.e_prod_award_e: The product has won the gold medal in its category.
_u.e_resign_e: I quit! It's too boring to continue like this!
_u.e_sales_meet_e: Performance has declined due to insufficient customer demand.
_u.e_task_shorthanded_e: Shortage of staff in positions, high pressure.
_u.e_team_shorthanded_e: Your team is severely understaffed, and members are complaining. You need to fill the vacancies as soon as possible.
_u.e_sick_e: Sorry, I'm sick. The doctor has issued a sick leave note. I will come back after recovering.
_u.e_takeover_e: There are more and more rumors that your company may be acquired by a competitor. Team members find it difficult to convince customers that there is no risk of being abandoned even if there is a possibility of acquisition.
_u.e_offer_e: Received a job offer from a competitor. The incredible salary package and promotion make it hard to refuse.
_u.b_allApp: All team members recognize the leadership action you just executed, and your team's morale has improved. Keep it up!
_u.b_allRej: All team members feel that they cannot accept the leadership action you just executed. They feel that it does not help improve productivity. You should review your thinking.
_u.b_emotionOnly: Be careful to observe the emotional state of team members. Their emotions can affect work morale, leading to a decline in performance.
_u.b_halfApp: When team members' states are uneven, executing a unified leadership action often leads to inconsistent views among members, causing confusion.
_u.b_indApp: Team members recognize the leadership action you just executed.
_u.b_indApp_e: Team members recognize the leadership action you just executed, and performance has improved.
_u.b_indAppAff: Team members recognize the leadership action you just executed. However, the leadership action recognized by one employee may affect other employees, which may prevent you from achieving overall team performance improvement.
_u.b_indAppAff_e: Team members recognize the leadership action you just executed, and performance has improved. However, the leadership action recognized by one employee may affect other employees, which may prevent you from achieving overall team performance improvement.
